name: Black Iron
description: Dark timber, riveted black iron, and a restrained copper wind arrow.
notes: All layers use a centered 512 x 512 RGBA canvas. The letterless iron ring is intentionally quiet behind the runtime's upright cardinal glyphs.

orientationConventions.ring: The riveted cardinal index is north-up at 12 o'clock in the source texture. Apply heading only to the rose transform.
orientationConventions.windPointer: The copper arrow tip points to 12 o'clock at world bearing 0. Its circular boss is centered at (0.5, 0.5); mount it on the rose and apply pure world bearing.
orientationConventions.lubberMarker: Static screen-space layer. The downward brass point is baked at 12 o'clock and marks the player's facing.
